about: Market Test broker policy (Sat 3 Oct ~21:00, branch feat/bench-beat-stall, _night/BENCH_BEAT_STALL.md): which BAZAAR_BENCH_POLICY the maker runs on Sunday's Market Tests, and when the default-off code merges. Asked with the evidence in questions/bench.state.json (bench quotes are synthetic; no values of ours). Only a decided verdict is acted on, and every Railway or main change still needs Marius. Reproduce: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; uv run python -m bazaar_agent.jev judge --state questions/bench.state.json --questions questions/bench.json --log

instructions.question: Reading `state`, which bench policy should the maker's broker run from the h14.65 hard Market Test on: exact, probe_g10 or probe_g20?
instructions.note: exact is today's broker and ties the free stall (bench_points 0.5 in all 5 sessions so far). probe sends the exact plan first, unchanged, then a few pairs whose quotes do not cross (gap at most 10 or 20 P), priced between the quotes; at most 6 per session. Nobody knows whether the server accepts such a pair when both hidden limits allow the price (`state.unknown`). Bench points are worked out from the round-average efficiency, so a small margin above the stall over the remaining sessions may lift the whole round; a margin below costs little (`state.scoring`). Switching is one maker-only Railway variable.

criteria.exact: The probe's risks (`state.risks`) outweigh its expected gain, or the evidence that the server checks hidden limits is too weak to spend a session on.
criteria.probe_g10: Probing is worth it, and the smaller gap's half as many refused calls matters more than its slightly lower gain on books with heavy shading.
criteria.probe_g20: Probing is worth it, and the wider gap's extra gain on books with heavy shading matters more than its extra refused calls.

instructions.question: Reading `state`, when should the default-off probe code merge to main: tonight_after_duels, overnight_doors_closed or sunday_0900?
instructions.note: A merge redeploys maker, taker, duels and mcp together; with the policy variable at exact it changes no behaviour. The flip itself is a later maker-only variable change that must land before the h14.65 bench. The game is paused at tick 1201 (`state.clock`).

criteria.tonight_after_duels: Merging after h13 and Duels II end, before the 23:00 close, is safe enough and leaves the most time to verify before Sunday.
criteria.overnight_doors_closed: Merging while the doors are closed risks no tick of any agent, and leaves time to check the deploy before 09:00.
criteria.sunday_0900: Merging at the Sunday opening is enough, and nothing needs to change before then.
